description: Convert an amount from one currency to one or more targets at the reference rate for `date`, optionally PPP-adjusted. Use for any single-pair or amount conversion (for example "100 USD to EUR"). Use `get_rates`/`get_rates_by_base` for a full rate table, `get_history` for a series, and the `analyze_*` tools for statistics. `amount` defaults to 1 (each result then equals the rate); `ppp=true` applies purchasing-power parity and needs `CUR:COUNTRY` when a currency is used in more than one country; `date` must be today or earlier and defaults to the latest rate date. Returns `{ from, amount, date, results[] }`, each result carrying `result`, `rate`, and an optional `ppp` block. Invalid codes or dates return a 4xx error; no rate for the date is a 404. Requires a signed-in connection; each successful call bills 1 API request.

amount.description: Amount to convert. Optional, defaults to 1 (so each result equals the rate). When provided it must be a finite positive number.

date.description: Rate date in YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Must not be in the future. Defaults to latest.

from.description: Source currency (ISO 4217), e.g. USD. For PPP (ppp=true), pass CUR:COUNTRY (e.g. USD:USA) when the currency is used in more than one country; common currencies are resolved automatically.

ppp.description: When true, apply a PPP adjustment. Pass CUR:COUNTRY for currencies used in more than one country; common currencies (USD, EUR, INR and others) resolve automatically.

to.description: One or more target currencies, comma-separated, e.g. EUR,INR (max 25). For PPP, pass CUR:COUNTRY pairs (e.g. EUR:DEU,INR:IND) when a currency is used in more than one country; common currencies are resolved automatically.

name: convert
title: Convert currency
